# Email for notification type access_changed (notifications.TypeAccessChanged): refactor plan step S10.
# Regenerate (a deliberate, release-noted behavior change only):
#   UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./internal/notify -count=1 -run '^TestNotificationContent$'
# Emailed by default (OPENV_EMAIL_NOTIFICATION_TYPES unset): yes. The override run sets it to exactly the
# types the defaults leave out. Each message is the SMTP hand-off of the real mailer;
# every line ends CRLF on the wire (a bare LF would show as ␊, a bare CR as ␍).

======== org.member_added: an admin adds a member | delivery 1 of 2 | to user-ben
with the default allow-list: sent; with the override: not sent
envelope: smtp.example.test:587, MAIL FROM openv@example.test, RCPT TO ben@example.test, no auth
-------- message
From: openv@example.test
To: ben@example.test
Subject: You joined a workspace
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8

You joined a workspace

You are now a member of this workspace with a member role.

Open it in OpenV:
https://openv.example.test/org/settings?tab=members

—
You are receiving this because email notifications are enabled for your OpenV account. Turn them off in Settings → Notifications.
-------- end

======== org.member_role_changed: a member is made an admin | delivery 1 of 2 | to user-ben
with the default allow-list: sent; with the override: not sent
envelope: smtp.example.test:587, MAIL FROM openv@example.test, RCPT TO ben@example.test, no auth
-------- message
From: openv@example.test
To: ben@example.test
Subject: Your workspace access changed
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8

Your workspace access changed

Your role in this workspace is now an admin.

Open it in OpenV:
https://openv.example.test/org/settings?tab=members

—
You are receiving this because email notifications are enabled for your OpenV account. Turn them off in Settings → Notifications.
-------- end

======== org.member_removed by an admin | delivery 1 of 2 | to user-ben

-------- end
